# aidial_key (Resource)

Manages an API key bound to a role in DIAL Core (`PUT /v1/keys/{bucket}/{path}`). The secret `key` is never returned by the API; the value from configuration is kept in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aidial_bucket" "current" {}

variable "aidial_key_value" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "aidial_key" "example" {
  bucket = data.aidial_bucket.current.bucket
  path   = "my-key"

  key     = var.aidial_key_value
  project = "my-project"
  role    = "developer"
  roles   = ["developer"]
  secured = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String, Sensitive) DIAL API key value.
- `path` (String) Key path inside the target bucket.

### Optional

- `bucket` (String) Target DIAL bucket. Defaults to "platform" when not set.
- `project` (String) Project associated with the key.
- `role` (String) Primary role associated with the key.
- `roles` (Set of String) Roles associated with the key.
- `secured` (Boolean) Whether the key is secured.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) Key name returned by the DIAL API.
- `status` (String) Key status returned by the DIAL API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <bucket>/<path>.
terraform import aidial_key.example platform/my-key
```
